title: Day-of-month conditioned order-statistic marginal calibration
hypothesis: The calendar day-of-month may contain incremental information about the five ordered order-statistic marginals beyond the exact uniform 5-of-40 order-statistic null and a global empirical order-statistic baseline.
estimand: For each sorted position j=1..5, predict P(P_j=x | prior draws, target day-of-month) and score the five marginal distributions. This is not a joint five-number probability and does not generate a cinquina.

M1.name: Global empirical order-statistic marginal with fixed shrinkage

walk_forward.update_rule: Score target using only earlier draws; update global and day-of-month counts only after all five target positions are scored.

selection.criterion: minimum Validation mean marginal position log-loss averaged across five order-statistic positions

metrics: mean marginal position log-loss across five positions
mean marginal Brier across 5 positions x 40 values

inference.method: one-sided paired block sign-flip for improvement
inference.extended_calendar_family: Recompute Holm across 12 endpoints: four each from Q117 weekday-conditioned inclusion, Q118 month-of-year inclusion, and Q119 day-of-month order-statistic marginals.

integrity_checks: exact order-statistic null normalization for each position
limitations: The five marginal position distributions do not specify a valid joint distribution over the ordered five-number draw.
Historical Blind OOS is not a virgin holdout after prior SONAR research.
The calendar family is exploratory; Holm across Q117-Q119 covers 12 selected endpoints only, not the full Q00-Q119 research family.
Day-of-month groups have limited effective sample size; hierarchical shrinkage may dominate.
This is a research diagnostic, not the production SONAR scorer or a Q60 forecast.
guardrails: No Q60 record or existing freeze changes.
Do not reconstruct missing historical freezes.
